sections.section: RULES - Provincial Assembly of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Procedure and Conduct of Business Rules 1988
sections.description:
PROVINCIAL ASSEMBLY OF KHYBER PAKHTUNKHWA
PROVINCIAL ASSEMBLY OF KHYBER PAKHTUNKHWA
PROCEDURE AND CONDUCT OF BUSINESS RULES, 1988
(Substitution of words N.-W.F.P)
[Gazette of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, Extraordinary,
31st October, 2012]
No. PA/Khyber Pakhtunkhwa/Legis-I/2012/7981, dated
23-2-2013.---In exercise of the powers conferred on me by rule 250 of the
Provincial Assembly of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Procedure and Conduct of Business
Rules, 1988, I do hereby authenticate the amendments in the rules ibid
which were unanimously
passed by the
Provincial Assembly of Khyber
Pakhtunkhwa in its
meeting held on
20th February, 2012.
"Substitution of
the words "North-West Frontier
Province (N.-W.F.P.)" wherever occurring in the Provincial Assembly
Procedure and Conduct of Business Rules, 1988, by the words "Khyber
Pakhtunkhwa."
